title: Smoked Spanish Chicken Fajitas
description: Spicy fajitas made with smoked chicken, sautéed with garlic, bell peppers, and onions, served with warm flour tortillas.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the bell peppers and onions and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the stir-fry sauce (if using) and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Warm flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the fajitas by placing the chicken and vegetable mixture onto the tortillas and serving hot.
